payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into how counterfactual data augmentation affects gender bias in predictions and performance, specifically in Neural Relation Extraction systems.

claims.text: Counterfactual Data Augmentation (CDA) mitigates contextual biases by equalizing the contexts for masculine and feminine words in training data, leading to reduced gender bias in predictions.
Using counterfactual data augmentation improves model performance when training data contains contextual biases, effectively reducing gender bias in predictions.
The evaluation of NRE systems shows that debiasing methods, including counterfactual data augmentation, can effectively mitigate gender bias in model predictions.
